design.quote: randomised 2:1 proportion of participants added intermittent fasting (IF) in the last 3 months.

population.quote: initial mean HbA1c of 6.7 ± 0.7%, mean T2D duration of 7.4 ± 6.7 years

intervention.quote: a 6-month programme based on ultra-processed food intake reduction, a Mediterranean diet, and physical training.
intervention.value: ultra-processed food intake reduction, Mediterranean diet, and physical training

comparator.quote: Participants randomised to the IF add-on intervention group did not show significant additional improvement.

primary_findings.quote: mean weight loss of -6.8 kg (-9.3 to -4.4, p < 0.001)
